label: Di kelas (Front View)
prompt:
Image editing task using 2 reference images.
Reference-1: main subject
Reference-2: OSIS logo


[Task 0: Subject Consistency — CRITICAL]
* Keep the exact number of people from the original image
* Do NOT add or remove any person
* Preserve original group composition and spacing as much as possible
* Do NOT assume fixed number of subjects

IDENTITY PRESERVATION (CRITICAL):
* Preserve exact facial identity from the original image
* Maintain facial structure, proportions, and unique features
* Do NOT alter face shape, eyes, nose, mouth, or expression
* Keep original likeness highly recognizable
* Do NOT re-generate or stylize faces
* Face must remain identical to the original input (high fidelity)


[Task 1: Indonesian SMA Uniform]
Replace outfit with Indonesian public high school uniform.

Rules (HARD LOCK):
* White shirt, clean, 1 pocket
* OSIS logo on pocket (exact match, no text, small and proportional, max ~1/3 pocket width, not dominant)
* No blazer/tie/vest, not office wear

Bottom color (HARD LOCK):
* Light bluish grey similar to #72829f
* Typical Indonesian SMA uniform color
* Slight blue tint clearly visible
* Medium-light tone (NOT dark grey, NOT charcoal, NOT black)
* Avoid dull or muddy grey
* Color must appear brighter than neutral grey

CONSISTENCY RULE (IMPORTANT):
* All bottom clothing (pants and skirts) must use identical color tone (no variation across subjects)

Clothing:
* Male: long pants
* Female: skirt
* Hijab:
  - Long skirt (below knee–ankle), modest
  - Long sleeves (full arm coverage to wrist)
  - No visible skin on arms
* Sleeves follow original (except hijab must be long sleeve)

Shoes & socks:
* Black casual school shoes (canvas, low-top sneakers)
* Youth casual sneaker style, commonly worn by Indonesian students
* White or neutral ankle socks (short, visible)
* NOT mid-calf or long socks

Remove: accessories, layers, non-uniform items
Keep: face, identity, expression, hairstyle, proportions
Style: Indonesian student, natural, not formal


[Task 2: Classroom Environment]
Adapt the scene into an Indonesian high school classroom environment while preserving subject identity and proportions.

CLASSROOM SETTING (WOOD FOCUS):
* Interior Indonesian high school classroom
* School desks and chairs made of wood (jati or similar)
* Visible natural wood grain texture (clear but not exaggerated)
* Slightly worn surface (light scratches, uneven tone)
* Matte wood finish (NOT glossy, NOT polished modern furniture)
* Metal frame allowed for chair legs (typical school style)
* Green chalkboard behind
* Natural daylight from windows (soft side lighting)
* Realistic classroom, slightly aged, not modern or minimalistic


SEATING & COMPOSITION (ADAPTIVE — DO NOT FORCE COUNT):

* Adapt seating based on the number of subjects in the original image:

- If 1 subject:
  * Single student seated at a desk, facing camera

- If 2 subjects:
  * Both seated at the same desk or nearby desks, facing camera naturally

- If 3 or more subjects:
  * Some subjects seated together at desks
  * One or more subjects standing naturally beside or behind desks

* Do NOT create additional people to satisfy composition
* Composition must adapt to existing subjects only
* Maintain visibility of all faces
* No overlapping faces
* Keep spacing natural like real classroom interaction


POSE & INTERACTION:
* Seated subjects:
  - Sitting upright or slightly relaxed
  - Hands on desk or lap
* Standing subjects:
  - Relaxed stance, slight lean toward group or desk
  - Natural, friendly interaction

* Keep head position close to original image
* No stiff posing
* No exaggerated gestures


INTERACTION & REALISM:
* Bodies aligned correctly with chairs (no floating)
* Proper sitting contact (hips on chair, feet to floor)
* Correct human-to-furniture scale


CAMERA & FRAMING (WITH ANGLE CONTROL):
* Use a medium-wide framing (not close-up)
* Subjects visible from at least waist-up to full body (depending on composition)
* Include surrounding classroom elements (desks, chairs, board, partial room context)
* Keep subjects as the main focus, but environment must be clearly visible

* CAMERA ANGLE RULE:
  - If 1–2 subjects: use frontal view (subjects facing camera, not angled)
  - If 3 or more subjects: allow slight natural angle variation (not extreme side view)

* Natural perspective like a real classroom photo (not zoomed-in portrait)
* Avoid tight cropping on faces or upper body only


Lighting:
* Soft natural indoor lighting
* Match light direction across subjects and environment
* Add realistic contact shadows (under chairs, feet, desks)


GROUND & INTEGRATION:
* Floor must match classroom environment
* No visible leftover from the original ground
* No cutout or floating effect


Hard constraints:
* Do NOT use dark grey, charcoal, or near-black tones (for uniform)
* Keep all original subjects (no extra/missing people)
* Do NOT add extra people
* Composition must not imply or introduce additional subjects
* Maintain visual balance (no element overly dominant)
* Clean, realistic, no artifacts


Final:
Natural Indonesian senior high school (SMA) classroom photo,
students sitting at desks facing camera,
cheerful, relaxed, cohesive, realistic,
with strong facial identity preservation and clear classroom environment.

label: Di lorong sekolah
prompt:
Image editing task using 4 reference images.
Reference-1: main subject (PRIMARY IDENTITY)
Reference-2: background (mushola courtyard)
Reference-3: OSIS logo (optional, low priority)
Reference-4: pose reference (LAYOUT ONLY — NOT HUMAN REFERENCE)


[GLOBAL PRIORITY — STRICT]

1. Facial identity from Reference-1 (ABSOLUTE)
2. Background structure from Reference-2
3. Pose layout from Reference-4 (LOW PRIORITY)

If conflict occurs:
* ALWAYS preserve face from Reference-1
* IGNORE pose if it affects identity


[IDENTITY LOCK — ABSOLUTE]

* Faces must EXACTLY match Reference-1
* Do NOT copy ANY facial feature from Reference-4

STRICT:
* Do NOT blend identities
* Do NOT modify expression
* Do NOT reinterpret face

Reference-4 MUST NOT influence:
* Face
* Head shape
* Expression
* Skin tone

FAIL CONDITION:
* If face changes → result is incorrect


[UNIFORM]

* Indonesian SMA uniform
* White shirt
* Bottom: light bluish grey (#72829f tone)
* Male: pants
* Female: skirt
* Hijab: long sleeve + long skirt
* Black shoes + short socks

Remove accessories
Keep identity


[BACKGROUND — HARD LOCK]

* Fully use Reference-2
* Preserve ALL objects (bench, floor, walls)
* Do NOT add, generate, extend, or duplicate any object


[POSE — LAYOUT ONLY (IMPORTANT)]

Reference-4 is NOT a human reference.

Treat it as:
* A simple spatial layout
* Position guide only

USE ONLY:
* Number of seated vs standing people
* Relative spacing between subjects
* Rough sitting positions

IGNORE COMPLETELY:
* Faces
* Body details
* Clothing
* Expressions


[SEATING RULE — CRITICAL]

* Sitting is allowed ONLY on the real bench from Reference-2
* If layout requires more seating than available:
  → extra subjects MUST stand

FORBIDDEN:
* Creating new bench
* Extending bench
* Sitting on pillar, air, or invisible surface


[ORIENTATION]

* Bodies follow direction of the bench (sideways / 3/4)
* Heads may slightly face camera
* Avoid fully front-facing group alignment


[STYLE]

* Natural, candid, relaxed
* Not formal group photo
* Slight asymmetry allowed


[CONTACT]

* Sitting subjects must fully touch bench
* Feet must match ground perspective


[CONSTRAINTS]

* No extra people
* No missing subjects
* No extra objects
* No duplicated bench
* No face alteration
* No distortion


Final:
Natural Indonesian SMA students in mushola courtyard,
pose loosely guided by layout reference,
sitting only on the existing bench,
faces identical to original input,
no added objects,
clean, realistic, and well-integrated.
